MATCH_START.label: Match start
MATCH_START.description: Your match is entering its launch: mark yourself ready, or it has just been launched.

SCORE_TO_CONFIRM.label: Score to confirm
SCORE_TO_CONFIRM.description: The opposing team entered a score that you need to confirm or dispute, or an entered score was confirmed automatically after at least 2 hours without an answer.

TOURNAMENT_START.label: Tournament kickoff
TOURNAMENT_START.description: A tournament your team is registered for has just started.

MATCH_REMINDER.label: Match times and reminders
MATCH_REMINDER.description: A match time when it is set, changed or removed, then reminders 24 h and 10 h before kickoff (with the check-in link).

TEAM_JOIN_REQUEST.label: Join requests
TEAM_JOIN_REQUEST.description: A player asks to join a team you manage.

CONTENT_REPORT.label: Reports about you
CONTENT_REPORT.description: A report targets your account or your team: you can appeal it.

MODERATION.label: Moderation decisions
MODERATION.description: Your avatar or your team's logo was hidden, deleted or restored, or your account suspended.

PRIVACY_CHANGE.label: Processing of your data
PRIVACY_CHANGE.description: The site changes what it collects or how it keeps it.

REFEREE_ALERT.label: Referee alerts
REFEREE_ALERT.description: A score conflict, a score dispute left too long without a referee or a reported problem is waiting for a referee.

REFEREE_SELF_RESOLUTION.label: Refereeing by a staff player
REFEREE_SELF_RESOLUTION.description: Another staff member, who plays in the match, has just settled its score dispute, corrected its result, imposed their opponent's withdrawal or paused its automatic confirmation.

MATCH_SCHEDULED.label: Scheduled matches
MATCH_SCHEDULED.description: Another referee schedules a match, or changes or removes its time — or a tournament update deletes a scheduled match.

REFEREE_DIGEST.label: Refereeing schedule
REFEREE_DIGEST.description: About 10 hours ahead, the list of upcoming matches: times, tournaments and teams.

REFEREE_RELEASED.label: Refereeing removed
REFEREE_RELEASED.description: The staff removes you as a match's referee, gives it to another referee or switches it to self-management, or it is removed automatically: the reason is given.

CAST_RELEASED.label: Cast removed
CAST_RELEASED.description: Your caster registration for a match is removed by the staff or automatically: the reason is given.

STAFF_REPORT.label: Incoming reports
STAFF_REPORT.description: A new report, or an appeal, reaches moderation.
